items.source: NOTE: Configuring BEFORE_TEST_CLASS as the execution phase causes the test's ApplicationContext to be eagerly loaded during test class initialization which can potentially result in undesired side effects. For example, @DynamicPropertySource methods will be invoked before @BeforeAll methods when using BEFORE_TEST_CLASS.
items.translation: NOTE: 将 `BEFORE_TEST_CLASS` 配置为执行阶段会导致测试的 `ApplicationContext` 在测试类初始化期间被急切加载，这可能会产生不期望的副作用。例如，使用 `BEFORE_TEST_CLASS` 时，@DynamicPropertySource 方法将在 `@BeforeAll` 方法之前被调用。

items.source: Specifically, the configured SQL scripts and statements will be executed prior to any before class lifecycle methods of a particular testing framework — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeAll annotation.
items.translation: 具体来说，配置的 SQL 脚本和语句将在特定测试框架的任何before class 生命周期方法之前执行——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的@BeforeAll注解的方法。

items.source: Specifically, the configured SQL scripts and statements will be executed after any after class lifecycle methods of a particular testing framework — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @AfterAll annotation.
items.translation: 具体来说，配置的 SQL 脚本和语句将在特定测试框架的任何类生命周期后方法之后执行——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的@AfterAll注解的方法。

items.source: Specifically, the configured SQL scripts and statements will be executed prior to any before test lifecycle methods of a particular testing framework — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @BeforeEach annotation.
items.translation: 具体来说，配置的 SQL 脚本和语句将在特定测试框架的任何before test lifecycle methods之前执行——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的@BeforeEach注解的方法。

items.source: Specifically, the configured SQL scripts and statements will be executed after any after test lifecycle methods of a particular testing framework — for example, methods annotated with JUnit Jupiter's @AfterEach annotation.
items.translation: 具体来说，配置的 SQL 脚本和语句将在特定测试框架的任何after test lifecycle methods之后执行——例如，带有 JUnit Jupiter 的@AfterEach注解的方法。
